input.text: This sprint we cut checkout from five steps to two, added Apple Pay, and saw abandoned carts drop from 31% to 18% in the first week.

Standup notes: Priya is blocked on the Stripe webhook signature check. Marcus finished the onboarding email. Demo dry run moves to Thursday at 3pm. We still need a fallback screen for when the model is slow.
The library extends weekend hours to 10pm starting in November.
